coverage_gaps.description: Cell list omits several relevant CZ deposit-takers and specialised banks whose leadership moves matter to the same market map: Hypoteční banka, ČSOB Stavební spořitelna, Modrá pyramida (KB group), Stavební spořitelna České spořitelny, Max banka, mBank CZ branch, ING CZ, J&T Banka, PPF banka, Wüstenrot.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the newsroom roster to these entities in a follow-up slice; group subsidiaries often announce director-level changes their parent bank does not.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell is newsroom-only by design, so it cannot see leadership changes that are legally registered but never announced (obchodní rejstřík / justice.cz filings of statutory-body changes, ČNB's list of licensed persons and management approvals).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this cell with a registry/regulator cell (justice.cz, ČNB seznamy a evidence) so silent changes are still captured with exact legal effective dates.

coverage_gaps.description: Newsrooms cover appointments well but rarely cover ordinary hiring volume, team build-outs, or layoffs. The 'jobs/hiring' topic is therefore under-served by this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a careers-portal cell (kariera/kariéra subdomains of the same banks) plus job-board and works-council surfaces to carry the hiring-volume signal.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language mirrors exist for several issuers (fio.cz/about-us/media/press-releases, unicreditbank.cz/en/, csob.cz EN portal) but were not systematically enumerated; EN mirrors sometimes lag or omit local appointment releases.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Record cs/en URL pairs per issuer and always treat the cs page as authoritative for effective dates and titles.

coverage_gaps.description: No liveness or robots/ToS check was performed on any listed URL in this pass, and some portal URLs (ČSOB Liferay asset_publisher links) are query-parameter heavy and may not be stable canonical addresses.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic verification pass, and prefer canonical slugs over asset_publisher query URLs when seeding crawlers.

brief: Czech bank newsrooms are a strong, primary-source-rich surface for A5: the big four (KB, Česká spořitelna, ČSOB, MONETA) plus Raiffeisenbank all run structured, year- or date-partitioned Czech press archives that name incoming and outgoing board members, their portfolios and exact effective dates, and the listed issuers (KB, MONETA) duplicate the same events in mandatory investor disclosures that are cleaner still. Smaller and newer players (Trinity, Partners Banka, Creditas, Air Bank, Fio) publish real leadership news but on thinner, less regular surfaces — often a single slug page rather than an indexed archive — so their index paths need nav resolution before crawling. Czech payment institutions are the weak flank: Global Payments Česko and Worldline CZ have localised sites but no observable Czech appointment-release stream, pushing that signal to the ČTK Protext wire and to registry sources outside this cell. Recommended posture: weekly crawls of the five large newsrooms plus investor-disclosure pages as the backbone, monthly crawls of the small banks, and Protext/Peníze.cz as pointer feeds that flag when a primary release exists.
